items.why: Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575 on AI agent demand, and Mizuho lifted its target to $705. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase chip supply in 2027. Shares set a fresh record high.
The fear gauge is sliding as stocks set records. With the S&P 500 at a new high and Treasury yields backing off multi-year peaks, demand for downside hedges is fading.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Megacaps are doing the heavy lifting as the S&P 500 hits a new high. Microsoft is one of the names carrying the market into earnings season alongside Nvidia and Apple, per Yahoo Finance.

market_note: Futures were higher earlier on dipping Treasury yields and softer oil prices.
summary: The S&P 500 hit a new record high Tuesday, shrugging off bond market turmoil as big tech carried the tape and attention turned to the start of earnings season.
